ext_description.message: Saves the page you are looking at as a ZIP with its styles, images and fonts, so it opens offline exactly as you saw it.
ext_description.description: Store and browser description: the single purpose (max 132 characters).

action_title.message: Save this page for offline use (ZIP)

app_name.description: Heading of the popup (the product name).

other_tab.message: This is the capture of another tab. It must finish, or be cancelled, before this tab can be captured.
other_tab.description: Shown when the popup is opened on a tab other than the one being captured.

help.description: Title of the collapsible help section.

help_intro.message: This popup saves the page you are looking at as a ZIP that opens offline. Snapshot reads the page, steps through each carousel, reuses the files the page already loaded and downloads the rest; Download then saves the ZIP to your Downloads folder.

help_close_label.description: Bold start of a help item.

help_close.message: (or click on the page) while a snapshot runs: it carries on. Click the extension's icon again to see how it is going; the finished ZIP waits there for Download. The icon's badge shows … while it runs, ✓ when it is done and ! if it failed.
help_close.description: Rest of the help item after help_close_label.

help_cancel.message: stops a snapshot in progress (carousels go back to their item) and closes the popup; on a finished snapshot, it discards it without saving.
help_cancel.description: Help item after the Cancel button's name.

help_download.message: saves the finished snapshot (.zip or .wsnp) to your Downloads folder and gets the popup ready for the next snapshot. Nothing is saved until you press it.
help_download.description: Help item after the Download button's name.

help_one.message: One capture runs at a time. While the capture runs, the browser shows an "Extension started debugging this browser" bar on the page; it is used to read the files the page already loaded and goes away at the end.
help_one.description: Help item about one capture at a time and the debugging bar.

help_unzip.message: Unzip the file and open index.html. Anything that could not be saved is listed below the results and is left out of the snapshot, which never goes online.

help_full.description: Link at the end of the popup's Help to the full help page.

help_page.description: File name of the help page in this language (not shown).

steps_label.description: Accessible name of the list of steps.

error_tab_gone.message: The tab to capture no longer exists.

error_page_blocked.message: The browser does not allow reading this page ($1). Pages such as chrome:// and the extension store are off limits.

step_editors_reading.message: Looking for code editors and reading their text…

step_editors_read_one.message: Read the full text of 1 code editor from the page

step_editors_read_other.message: Read the full text of $1 code editors from the page

step_dom_copying.message: Copying the page: DOM, styles, form values…

step_dom_copied.message: Copied the page: DOM, styles, form values

carousel_probe.message: Carousel $1 of $2: checking how it works…

carousel_restore.message: Carousel $1 of $2: putting your page back to item 1…

step_debugger_asking.message: Asking the page which files it has already loaded…

step_debugger_ok_one.message: The page has 1 file loaded that can be reused (no re-download)

step_debugger_ok_other.message: The page has $1 files loaded that can be reused (no re-download)

step_debugger_failed.message: Could not read the page's loaded files ($1); only files from the page's own site can be saved

step_assets_finding.message: Finding and downloading the page's resources…

assets_saved_page.description: Appended to assets_saved: how many were read from the page.

assets_saved_failed.description: Appended to assets_saved: how many failed.

step_files_saved_one.message: Saved 1 downloadable file next to the page

step_files_saved_other.message: Saved $1 downloadable files next to the page

status_saved_one.message: $1 is ready ($2 MB, 1 resource; $3). Press Download to save it.
status_saved_one.description: Final status; $1 = file name, $3 = origin_debugger or origin_no_debugger.

status_saved_other.message: $2 is ready ($3 MB, $1 resources; $4). Press Download to save it.
status_saved_other.description: Final status; $1 = number of resources, $2 = file name, $4 = origin_debugger or origin_no_debugger.

note_editors_one.message: 1 code/text editor saved as scrollable, selectable text ($1 from the complete linked file, $2 read from the editor).

note_editors_other.message: $1 code/text editors saved as scrollable, selectable text ($2 from the complete linked file, $3 read from the editor).

note_editors_partial_one.message: 1 editor could only be saved with the lines that were on screen when you captured.

note_editors_partial_other.message: $1 editors could only be saved with the lines that were on screen when you captured.

note_files_one.message: 1 linked file (downloads, attachments) saved next to the page.

note_files_other.message: $1 linked files (downloads, attachments) saved next to the page.

failed_summary_one.message: 1 resource could not be saved (its reference was removed so the page never goes online)

failed_summary_other.message: $1 resources could not be saved (their references were removed so the page never goes online)

reason_no_debugger.message: needs the debugger, which could not be attached

option_reveal.message: Load the whole page first: scroll to the end and press “Load more”, so everything is saved

option_format.description: Popup option: label of the .zip / .wsnp radio buttons.

help_format.message: .zip (the default) is a plain ZIP; .wsnp is the same snapshot as a Web SNaPshot file, with a manifest naming the page’s address, title and description, and a preview. Rename a .wsnp to .zip to unzip it.

step_reveal.message: Scrolling through the page so everything loads…

help_reveal_label.description: Bold start of a help item (the option's name).

help_reveal.message: (on unless you turn it off): before saving, PageKeep scrolls through the page and presses its “Load more” buttons, so images and lists that only appear then are saved too; it then goes back to where you were.

note_frame_pictures_one.message: 1 frame from another site (an ad, a video or map player) saved as a picture of how it looked.
note_frame_pictures_one.description: Result note: frames from other sites saved as pictures.

note_frame_pictures_other.message: $1 frames from other sites (ads, video or map players) saved as pictures of how they looked.

note_gallery_one.message: 1 gallery picture saved in full size; it opens over the page as on the site.
note_gallery_one.description: Result note: pictures of a photo gallery (lightbox) saved.

note_gallery_other.message: $1 gallery pictures saved in full size; they open over the page as on the site.

snapshot.description: Button: start the snapshot of the page.

download.description: Button: save the finished ZIP and get the popup ready for the next snapshot.

status_idle.message: Ready to save this page. Press Snapshot.

status_downloading.message: Saving the ZIP to your Downloads folder…

help_snapshot.message: starts saving this page (the option below it decides whether the whole page is loaded first).
help_snapshot.description: Help item after the Snapshot button's name.

help_key.message: Signing key of the .wsnp files this browser saves (tell the viewer it is yours):
help_key.description: Popup Help line before the fingerprint of the signing key.

copy.description: Button that copies the signing key's fingerprint.

copied.description: The Copy button's text for a moment after copying.
